name: VICNET
summary: Victorian community/education ISP run by the State Library of Victoria and RMIT (AS7637); launched May 1995 to provide free and low-cost internet access, hosting and web services to communities, public libraries and non-profits; a Victoria Internet Exchange (VIX) member; connectivity role wound down from the late 2000s. Distinct from the modern vicnet.com.au network-monitoring firm.

events.details: Communally launched by the State Library of Victoria and RMIT to bring internet access to Victorian communities and libraries.
Vicnet closed as a business unit by the State Library of Victoria; not sold/acquired.
